Codex code_generation has runtime-routed real execution. Kimi now has a feature-flagged Gateway real dispatch path (14-layer stack: stubs -> dry-run -> audit -> executor -> command executor -> Gateway -> shadow sidecar -> runtime attachment -> real dispatch -> fallback -> observability -> guardrails), ready for controlled llm_task dispatch only (verdict: READY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS). Hermes now has a default-off Gateway real dispatch sidecar stack for review/code_review/validation with fallback policy, sanitized observability, operational guardrails, final readiness verdict READY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS, a plan-only controlled rollout plan, checklist-only rollout validation, a runbook-only operator guide, a template-only post-enablement review template, a contract-only phase-2 expansion contract defining future code_review/validation expansion targets, a checklist-only phase-2 validation checklist, a runbook-only phase-2 operator runbook, a template-only phase-2 post-validation review template, a review-only phase-2 final readiness review, a plan-only phase-2 controlled enablement plan, and a contract-only phase-2 enablement guard contract defining mandatory guard conditions before any future implementation PR; it still does not own Gateway primary result or Runtime final_status/routing. A guardrail-contract-only phase-2 shadow enablement guardrail contract is now in place.
risks.mitigation: Kimi Gateway real dispatch is feature-flagged and wired (READY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS). Hermes Gateway real dispatch has a contract-only phase-2 enablement guard contract for future operator-managed enablement. Next step is a phase-2 shadow enablement contract.
